addresses: C6 of the T4E.41 acceptance -- evidence that scales with the group
claim_boundary: This is arithmetic over scene counts, bound to results already in the record. It states what any size-scaled criterion must survive; it does not propose one, and satisfying every constraint here would not make a candidate correct.

constraints.constraint: A surrogate must not be able to reconstruct the set it is testing.
constraints.forbids: any null built by redistributing the partition's own configurations
constraints.measured: a redistribution surrogate reassembles the motif at 0.015432 per replicate and 0.9547 over 199 replicates at S = 6

constraints.constraint: A null that changes pairwise distances per replicate is not runnable.
constraints.forbids: a per-replicate generative null at the declared richness levels
constraints.measured: matching costs 0.8 s, 13.5 s and 95.3 s per partition at richness 6, 9 and 12; a generative null invalidates the cached matrix and returns the cost to the measured 189 hours at richness 12 alone

constraints.constraint: K1 and K2 together admit only two shapes: a surrogate pool that excludes the set under test, or no per-size surrogate at all.
constraints.established_by: the conjunction of K1 and K2
constraints.forbids: presenting either shape as unconstrained; each carries a stated cost
constraints.measured: the exclusion repair has a reassembly rate of exactly zero by construction and keeps the cached matrix, at a bias toward false admission that a candidate must quantify before adoption

constraints.constraint: A bar calibrated on one partition may not be applied to another.
constraints.forbids: cross-partition calibration of an absolute diameter, and repair by that normaliser
constraints.measured: four blocks from one generator differ 1.88x in mean same-configuration distance, while the label-free close-pair normaliser varies only 1.084x and measures the nearest unrelated distance rather than the same-configuration one

constraints.forbids: widening S to rescue a criterion
constraints.measured: the reassembly rate falls quickly with S, which is exactly why moving it is forbidden: a partition size chosen to make a rule pass is evidence tuned to the rule

constraints.constraint: A ninth candidate inherits eight declared attempts' multiplicity.
constraints.forbids: reporting a first success as though it were a single test, and opening 720-735 or 880-895 without an amendment
constraints.measured: eight criteria declared and falsified; two reserves remain unspent and unspendable without their own amendments

exclusion_variant.bias_mechanism: the excluded members are the tightest group in the partition, so the surrogate pool loses its closest configurations and the tightest surrogate set of the same size is looser than it would otherwise be
exclusion_variant.not_measured_because: a set cannot be drawn from a pool it is not in; simulating this would report zero by construction and look like a measurement
exclusion_variant.what_a_candidate_using_this_owes: a quantification of that bias, derived before adoption, not a pass reported after it
exclusion_variant.why: the members of the set under test are not in the pool the surrogate draws from, so no redistribution of that pool can produce them

t4e16_withdrawal_reason: The surrogate can reassemble the very structure it exists to destroy. It redistributes the partition's ACTUAL configurations, so when the S motif copies happen to land in S distinct scenes they form the same consistent set with exactly the same diameter. The rule admits only a set strictly tighter than the tightest surrogate set of its size, so a single such replicate sets the bar at the motif's own diameter and the motif is rejected.
what_this_is_not: It is not a criterion, a candidate, or a design for one.
It adjudicates nothing and measures no signature, partition or distance.
It does not meet C6, and registering it against C6 would be a category error: C6 asks for a criterion, and this is the set of limits one would have to satisfy.
It opens no reserve and spends no evidence.
